title: Inconsistent charset handling
detail: The method currently encodes the data as UTF-8 regardless of the charset specified in the Content-Type header, which can lead to incorrect data handling.

title: Missing charset handling in test
detail: The test does not handle the case where the Content-Type header declares a charset that is not UTF-8, which can lead to silent data corruption or errors during decoding.

title: Incorrect handling of hidden comments

title: Crash on consecutive `# fmt: skip` statements
detail: The code fails to format correctly when two statements with `# fmt: skip` are placed consecutively, causing a crash due to internal errors.
